summary: Re-ran every finding from both code-review reports (SPEC: L01-SPEC-01..08; STANDARDS: STD-1..4) against the lane's current head (abc29ff5). All eight SPEC findings and all four STANDARDS findings are genuinely disposed: five 'major/minor/note' code findings are fixed and independently reproduced by reading the actual diff (not just trusting the fix report's prose), one minor finding (#848 AC3, L01-SPEC-05) is correctly left as a recorded, non-code disposition with the exact GitHub-comment text drafted for the orchestrator to post -- per this task's own rule, a finding whose only remaining remedy is a GitHub write and whose text is already recorded is a note, not an open item -- and three note-severity findings (L01-SPEC-07, L01-SPEC-08, STD-4) are wording/process corrections the fix report correctly declined to act on this round (out of 'above note' scope) with an accurate rationale for each. Verified directly: home-board-mock.mjs's POPULATED_WORK_PACK now uses migration 0214's real field names (work_id/purpose/status/memo/attempts/current_run_status/retrying/created_at, plus receipt_id/entry_id/committed_at) with statuses from 0178's roster (running/completed); e2e-fixture-ownership.test.ts adds ARRAY_MEMBERSHIP_DISPATCH/arrayMembershipVerbs and five new SHARED_RPC_VERBS declarations (list_fiscal_years, list_agent_act_receipts, list_bank_accounts, list_bank_statements, list_uncoded_filings) plus a GREEN-after-correction cell (L01-SPEC-04) and a widened body-reader census (arrow-bound readJson/readBody plus a bare for-await drain, with a backtick-prose lookbehind guard verified against all four cited comment-only files); documents-intake-mock.mjs and chat-parity-mock.mjs no longer define private drains, both now alias the shared readCachedJson; activity-mock.mjs's pageHasWork derives truncation from PAGE_2's real membership instead of blanket-disabling pagination whenever p_work is present; apps/web/e2e/README.md's #848 coverage row now reads 'a forced denial rendering the database's own CLR04 owner-floor refusal (simulated at the wire ...)', matching the test's own corrected comment, replacing the old 'enforces' claim; the #902 cross-lane id-collision test now loops every other LANE_MOCKS file and asserts the id is absent, not only the one same-file comparison; journal-work-walk.spec.ts's control()/controlRead() now share one controlFetch() helper. Independently re-ran every gate on this head from a clean git status: apps/web/e2e/e2e-fixture-ownership.test.ts -> 44/44 pass (0 fail); pnpm typecheck -> exit 0 (apps/web + packages/runtime, Done); pnpm lint -> exit 0 (all workspaces, including the four selftest suites); the four touched-domain Playwright walks (journal-work-walk, activity-feed-walk, home-board-walk, accrual-walk) on the lane's own triple (3500/3501/3502) -> 81/81 pass, 0 fail; the whole apps/web unit suite (node scripts/run-tests.mjs) -> 4657 tests, 4655 pass, 0 fail, 2 skip (the 2 skips are pre-existing env-gated live-Supabase-provider tests unrelated to this diff, not new). git status is clean at abc29ff5 both before and after this recheck session (no edits made). Diff scope confirmed unchanged: only apps/web/e2e/*.mjs, two .spec.ts/.test.ts files, README.md and playwright.config.ts -- no migration, no packages/runtime file, no frozen-workflow file. Nothing above minor remains open; nothing new is broken.
